entries.land_description: Delphos is envisioned as a wilderness sanctuary, a womb-space for Lesbian sacred consciousness and all it gives birth to. The dream includes a long-term resident community, space for individual and group retreats, with rituals honoring the seasons, sun, moon, life changes, and healing space. NonLesbian women often welcome, men rarely. Having found an incredibly beautiful 240-acre farm surrounded by state forest near Duluth, MN, I am urgently looking for co-creators and co-dreamers. I am/have: one Lesbian, no land yet but hoping soon!

entries.community_name: ARCO IRIS - WOMYN OF COLOR LAND
entries.num_residents: two native/latina womyn, two teenage womyn
entries.land_description: We are two native/latina womyn, two teenage womyn, (non-vegetarian) working hard towards self-sufficiency, prosperity on the land. Spiritually directed by Native teachings and oneness with Mother Earth. We especially welcome womyn and children of color. All visits are by invitation only. No lazy, know-it-all moochers. Gun/drug/alcohol free space. No abuse of anything. Raise garden, goats, rabbits, chickens, ducks, geese, pigeons, corn. We welcome new residents/members, girl & boy children, nonlesbian women, farm dogs (neutered males). We have/are: many lesbians and nonlesbians, 120 acres, 2 housing/permanent structures, woods, camping space, women living and working on the land.
entries.welcomed_groups: womyn and children of color, new residents/members, girl & boy children, nonlesbian women, farm dogs (neutered males)

entries.land_description: (Located at 37010 SE Snuffin Rd, Estacada, OR 97023.) We are in the process of becoming a healing ground dedicated to healing ourselves, each other and the mother earth. One half hour from a natural hot springs, our forest farmland provides an ideal setting for hiking, fishing, berry picking, cookouts, meditating and relaxing, much more! Whole land may be available for lease or sale.
entries.welcomed_groups: new members/residents, Native American Women, Women of Color and White women, girl and boy children, nonlesbian women
entries.notes: We have/are: 5 lesbians, 2 nonlesbians, 52 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing, electricity, woods, farmland, camping space, women living and working on the land, guest house/retreat.

entries.land_description: Located in Pilon, Vieques, Puerto Rico 00765. We are developing a women's retreat on a quiet, sunny, laid-back island, between Puerto Rico and the Virgin Islands. November and December we'll be building a shelter, cutting mesquite and making our own environment. A carpentry course will be given. $150/week includes food and housing. Lots of free time and beautiful beaches to explore. Limit of 12 women at a time, no limit to number of weeks. Come back and enjoy the space Jan - April.
entries.notes: We have/are: 6 lesbians, 5 acres, housing/permanent structures, plumbing, electricity, camping space, women working on the land, developing a retreat.

entries.land_description: (Located at 300A Commercial St). Small guest house in center of town, 1/2 block from Boston Ferry, bus and beach, open year round. Large common room with cable TV, front yard, shared baths, front porch and deck with water view.
entries.notes: Pertinent rules - NO pets, kitchen privileges, private baths, personal checks nor credit cards.

entries.land_description: Lesbian owned, Lesbian space. Small, cozy, and magical cabin located in the Pisgah National Forest, Asheville, NC. Very private. 1 bedroom with waterbed. Totally furnished with women's artwork, women's books, antiques. Mountain stream, hiking trails. Everything you'll need. Three miles off Blue Ridge Parkway. $40/day. Minimum rental of 2 days, maximum 2 weeks.
